Hi — I need help with two failed deliveries: orders #5428 and #5411, $25 each, $50 total. Both were marked "delivered"; neither ever arrived. I checked with the neighbors and the building desk on both occasions, and I reported the first one immediately — that report was never answered, which is part of why I'm here now.

I'd like this fixed in one step: refund both orders together — $50 exactly, one transaction. I already know only one may show in your system — the second one was placed minutes later in the same session; both charges appear on my statement as identical $25 payments to QuickEats.
